claims: Nowruz is the Persian New Year.

Nowruz aligns with the vernal equinox.
Nowruz marks the official start of spring.
Nowruz is rooted in Iranian tradition and Zoroastrianism.

Nowruz represents the triumph of light over darkness.
Nowruz represents the start of spring.
